title: One-line trip summaries
prompt: Implement `trip_summary(trip)` in trips/summary.py. It returns the one-line summary shown in the trip list: the origin, ' to ', the destination, ': ' and how long the trip takes, e.g. 'Leeds to York: 1 h 05 min'. Durations must look the same as everywhere else on the site.
notes: util/timefmt.py already formats durations ('45 min', '2 h', rounding to the nearest minute). The lazy-wrong version formats its own and prints '0 h 45 min'.
extension: Overnight trips should say so: add ' (overnight)' when the trip arrives on a later day.
